args.body: For CATALOGUE-CAD60-HANDLING-TIME, reuse any completed verdict and run the existing timed rehearsal if still open under a valid lease. If director-cad60-delivery-ceilings.json commits, use it only where it adds a decision to the existing handoff. Separate measured delivery time from assumed acquisition, revision, admin and incremental costs. Record whether the measured rehearsal fits the provisional price under the stated scenarios and identify what only a real paid order could establish. Read back the evidence and close the mission with a lesson once its criteria are met. Preserve the exact draft and its existing operator decision.

description: The CanadaBuys screen found no matches in 30 new notices, and the open-notice feed exceeded the retrieval limit. A readable original notice with a separately quotable QA task would justify reopening that route. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The next actions test whether the provisional CAD 60 catalogue offer can cover delivery and acquisition labor while the existing SQLite package work continues independently.
